description: This file defines an interface (LibnmWrapsImpl) with various virtual functions for interacting with NetworkManager components, and a singleton wrapper class (LibnmWraps) that provides static access to these functions. It appears to be a mock or wrapper for testing or abstraction, focusing on NetworkManager API functions related to network devices, connections, IP configurations, access points, and WiFi scanning.

classes.name: LibnmWrapsImpl
classes.description: An interface class declaring virtual functions for interacting with NetworkManager entities, designed for mocking or abstraction in tests.
